name: battling ropes side raise
description: Raising battling ropes out to the side with a fast, wave-making motion. Boosts shoulder endurance and heart rate.
instructions: Stand in a slight squat holding a rope end in each hand.
Keep your core braced and elbows soft.
Raise both arms out to the sides to about shoulder height in a quick, controlled motion.
Lower and repeat at a steady fast pace.
